questions.question: Where was Guru Arjan Dev Ji born?
questions.explanation: Guru Arjan Dev Ji was born at Goindwal in 1563, the youngest son of Guru Ram Das Ji.
questions.source: SGPC: Sri Guru Arjan Dev Ji

questions.question: Who was the mother of Guru Arjan Dev Ji?
questions.explanation: Guru Arjan Dev Ji's mother was Bibi (Mata) Bhani Ji, daughter of Guru Amar Das Ji; Mata Ganga Ji was his wife.
questions.source: SGPC: Sri Guru Arjan Dev Ji

questions.question: Which shrine did Guru Arjan Dev Ji build in the middle of the Amritsar sarovar?
questions.explanation: Guru Arjan Dev Ji completed the sarovar and built Sri Harmandir Sahib (the Golden Temple) in its centre.
questions.source: The Sikh Encyclopedia: Arjan Dev, Guru

questions.question: Sukhmani Sahib, the 'Psalm of Peace', was composed by which Guru?
questions.explanation: Sukhmani Sahib is a composition of Guru Arjan Dev Ji, often rendered in English as the 'Psalm of Peace'.
questions.source: The Sikh Encyclopedia: Sukhmani

questions.question: In which city was Guru Arjan Dev Ji martyred?
questions.explanation: Guru Arjan Dev Ji was tortured and martyred in Lahore in 1606.
questions.source: Britannica: Guru Arjan

questions.question: Which Mughal emperor ordered the arrest and execution of Guru Arjan Dev Ji?
questions.explanation: Emperor Jahangir, who succeeded Akbar in 1605, had Guru Arjan Dev Ji arrested; his own memoir records that he ordered the execution.
questions.source: SGPC: Sri Guru Arjan Dev Ji

questions.question: Dasvandh, institutionalised by Guru Arjan Dev Ji, asks Sikhs to give what share of their earnings?
questions.explanation: Dasvandh means giving one-tenth of one's income for communal use; masands collected it from the sangats.
questions.source: The Sikh Encyclopedia: Arjan Dev, Guru

questions.question: Who succeeded Guru Arjan Dev Ji as the sixth Guru?
questions.explanation: Guru Arjan Dev Ji's only son, Guru Hargobind Sahib Ji, succeeded him in 1606.
questions.source: The Sikh Encyclopedia: Arjan Dev, Guru

questions.question: Sri Harmandir Sahib was built with doors facing all four directions. What does this symbolise?
options: That it was designed as a fort
That it is open to people of every caste and creed
The four seasons of the year
questions.explanation: The four doors symbolise that the Guru's house welcomes everyone, from every direction and background.
questions.source: The Sikh Encyclopedia: Arjan Dev, Guru

questions.question: According to Sikh tradition, which Sufi saint of Lahore laid the foundation stone of Sri Harmandir Sahib?
questions.explanation: Sikh tradition and SGPC hold that Hazrat Mian Mir, a Muslim saint of Lahore, laid the foundation stone of Sri Harmandir Sahib.
questions.source: SGPC: Sri Guru Arjan Dev Ji
questions.note: Phrased as 'according to Sikh tradition'; some historians question the account.

questions.question: Which town, with a large sarovar, did Guru Arjan Dev Ji found, where he also cared for people with leprosy?
questions.explanation: Guru Arjan Dev Ji founded Tarn Taran with a large tank and a gurdwara, and set up care for people with leprosy there.
questions.source: SGPC: Sri Guru Arjan Dev Ji

questions.question: The town of Kartarpur founded by Guru Arjan Dev Ji lies in which district?
questions.explanation: Guru Arjan Dev Ji founded Kartarpur in the Jalandhar Doab, about 15 km from Jalandhar city; it is different from Guru Nanak Dev Ji's Kartarpur on the Ravi.
questions.source: The Sikh Encyclopedia: Kartarpur

questions.question: Who wrote down the Adi Granth as scribe when Guru Arjan Dev Ji compiled it?
questions.explanation: Bhai Gurdas Ji was the scribe of the Adi Granth, installed in Sri Harmandir Sahib in 1604 with Baba Buddha Ji as the first granthi.
questions.source: SGPC: Sri Guru Arjan Dev Ji
questions.note: Only Adi Granth question in this category (GGS covered elsewhere).

questions.question: In which raag is Sukhmani Sahib composed?
questions.explanation: Sukhmani Sahib is in Raag Gauri, which is why it is titled 'Gauri Sukhmani' in Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji.
questions.source: The Sikh Encyclopedia: Sukhmani

questions.question: How many ashtpadis (cantos) are there in Sukhmani Sahib?
questions.explanation: Sukhmani Sahib has 24 ashtpadis, each of eight stanzas and each preceded by a salok.
questions.source: The Sikh Encyclopedia: Sukhmani

questions.question: Into which river was Guru Arjan Dev Ji taken at the time of his martyrdom in Lahore?
questions.explanation: After days of torture, Guru Arjan Dev Ji was taken to the river Ravi in Lahore, where he passed away in 1606.
questions.source: SGPC: Sri Guru Arjan Dev Ji

questions.question: Which gurdwara in Lahore marks the place of Guru Arjan Dev Ji's martyrdom?
questions.explanation: Gurdwara Dera (Dehra) Sahib, opposite Lahore's Badshahi Mosque, marks where Guru Arjan Dev Ji was martyred.
questions.source: SGPC: Gurdwara Dehra Sahib, Lahore

questions.question: Jahangir accused Guru Arjan Dev Ji of helping which rebel Mughal prince?
questions.explanation: Jahangir's son Khusrau rebelled and met Guru Arjan Dev Ji at Goindwal; after the revolt failed, the Guru was blamed for helping him.
questions.source: The Sikh Encyclopedia: Arjan Dev, Guru

questions.question: Sikh tradition blames which Lahore official, whose daughter's proposed marriage to Hargobind was turned down, for Guru Arjan Dev Ji's torture?
questions.explanation: Sikh tradition holds Chandu responsible after his proposal to marry his daughter to the young Hargobind was refused; historians see the emperor as the real cause.
questions.source: The Sikh Encyclopedia: Arjan Dev, Guru
questions.note: SE doubts Chandu's influence; question phrased as 'Sikh tradition blames'.

questions.question: Sukhmani Sahib was composed on the bank of which sarovar in Amritsar?
questions.explanation: The place where Guru Arjan Dev Ji composed Sukhmani Sahib is marked on the bank of the Ramsar pool in Amritsar.
questions.source: The Sikh Encyclopedia: Sukhmani
